justification: Mariota's tag flipped to Out, so that debate's over before it started — Caleb's Questionable, and Questionable isn't a tag that sits a man in this building. I don't roster two quarterbacks to play the backup over the guy I drafted to be the whole operation. Caleb starts, full stop, no eulogy for the arm I spent FAAB chasing three weeks running. Jeanty's Questionable too but he's still my highest-ceiling back on the field, 11-plus on paper, and I don't bench a guy who can end a game in two touches for a maybe; Skattebo and Judkins stay up top and at flex because they're the ones taking the top off a defense, not committee leftovers sitting on my own bench. Downs, Burden, and Kincaid ran it back because nothing's broken there, and Reichard and the Lions D round out a lineup that isn't getting redecorated over a projection gap that doesn't exist. We don't tank, we don't stream, we don't blink — Caleb plays hurt because I played hurt.
